name: myWeatherPanel
tagline: A Raspberry Pi that shows weather and news headlines on an RGB LED matrix.

name: tcamViewerDesktop
tagline: A Linux/desktop viewer for the tCam thermal imaging camera — a Compose Multiplatform Desktop port of tcamViewer2.

name: tcamViewer2
tagline: A ground-up Kotlin rewrite of tCamViewer for viewing and saving tCam thermal images.

name: tcamViewer2-rpi
tagline: A Raspberry Pi (arm64) port of tcamViewerDesktop for viewing tCam thermal cameras.

name: p1sTouchScreen-RPI
tagline: A PySide6 touchscreen GUI for a Raspberry Pi that controls a Bambu Lab P1S over local WiFi, emulating the Bambu A1's onboard control screens.

name: printWatcher
tagline: A Wear OS watch app and Android phone companion that show a Bambu Lab printer's progress on your wrist — tile, watch-face complication and alerts, all over the local network.

name: tCam-Mini P1S Mount
tagline: A 3D-printed case and pin-locked tilting mount that puts a tCam-Mini thermal camera in the front-left corner of a Bambu Lab P1S fitted with the Vented LED Riser.
